text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that enables computers to see and understand the world through images and videos. One of its core tasks is image recognition, where a computer identifies what is in a picture, such as a cat or a tree. Another important task is object detection, which goes further by locating objects within an image and drawing boxes around them. These technologies have many practical applications. For example, in self-driving cars, computer vision helps the vehicle recognize traffic lights, pedestrians, and other cars, allowing it to make safe decisions on the road. From medical scans to smartphone cameras, computer vision is changing how machines interact with our visual world.
